description: This Java class 'LinkManager' manages serial or TCP communication links, providing connection handling, thread management, and protocol-related utilities. It interacts with hardware interfaces and external connectors, facilitating communication setup, message unpacking, and error checking within a software project related to engine control or similar embedded system applications.

classes.name: LinkManager
classes.description: A class managing communication links, connection states, threading, and message processing for hardware interfaces.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to a specified port, waits for establishment or timeout.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets up the connector based on the port string, whether serial, TCP, or log viewer.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Starts connection process with a callback listener.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command through the connector, optionally firing an event.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the connection, resetting connection state.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a message packet using the current connector.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if an error exists in the connector.

methods.name: unpackConfirmation
methods.description: Extracts confirmation message contents if present.

methods.name: getDefaultPort
methods.description: Returns the last available serial port, or null if none found.
